It's gotten worse than it was when Maxizoo was there. Because there's so little staff, there's often no cashier present, which is understandable. What's not understandable is that they've removed that nice button that let customers know they were ready to pay, so you end up waiting in vain for a clerk to arrive and then having to search every corner of the store for someone to pay. This leads to long lines. They no longer have a Payback agreement, so it's even less convenient to shop there except for emergencies. It's a shame because I used to enjoy going there often with my dog.
